title: Grateful Dead Live at The Fabulous Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: Reel (Dolby B Decoded) -> WAV (24bit/96k)Mastering Info:Wav (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a peak‑era show highlighted by an epic Dark Star > St. Stephen > Mason’s sequence.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑Gans SBD source delivers a clean, well‑balanced picture of what many fans call a peak Dead performance.  The night is defined by a soaring Dark Star that flows into St. Stephen, Mason’s and a tight Good Lovin' / Uncle John's run, while the rest of the set stays solid with standout moments from Casey Jones and Mama Tried.  A few rough spots (notably an over‑eager Hard to Handle) don’t detract from the overall brilliance.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average >4), strong praise for musical highlights and a decent soundboard source; minor recording quirks noted but not detrimental.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller‑Gans SBD provides clear, well‑balanced audio.  Reviewers note occasional reel‑source speed changes and a brief drop‑out, but overall the tape sounds clean and listenable.

standout_songs: Dark Star > St. Stephen > Mason's > Good Lovin' > Uncle John's
show_quality.setlist_flow: One long, late‑starting set that moves from a tight early jam into an extended Dark Star suite, then rolls through solid mid‑tempo numbers before closing with the high‑energy Good Lovin'/Uncle John's segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Steps up with soaring guitar work on Dark Star; praised as peak performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir adds a Feelin' Groovy jam and solid rhythm throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten is absent; no specific keyboard commentary beyond that.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart ('Pig') gets ahead of the beat on Hard to Handle, but overall drumming remains strong.
